# coval_workspaces (Data Source)

Lists active and archived Coval workspaces for the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_workspaces" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `workspaces` (Attributes List) Organization workspaces, including the default workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))
